text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru was insistent on me coming to the shrine with her. I end up going, but…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: O god of vitality, would you please quell your anger so I may be entrusted with your energy?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sigh. It's no use. I'm still feeling the same as ever.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Well, I can't seem to shake off this fatigue… but I think I know why.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I've been so busy lately that I haven't paid my dues at the shrine. I must have angered the god of vitality! I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ngh, I guess there's no way out of this. I'll add a little more to my donation… Let's make it fifty yen and pray one more time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems she's still feeling tired. I should probably reevaluate her race schedule to ensure she can perform at her best going forward.
